WITH cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)
), act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT cur.member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN act.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN cur.member_id END) AS active_members,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_current
FROM cur LEFT JOIN act USING (member_id)
